summary: Wise Group plc furnished a Form 6-K attaching its Q2 FY27 results press release for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Cross-border volume rose 22% year over year to $71.7 billion, active customers grew 20% to 12.5 million, customer holdings increased 28% to $43.5 billion, and net revenue climbed 21% to $739.1 million. Cross-border take rate fell 3 basis points to 0.49% as Wise passed through operating leverage via lower pricing. FY27 net revenue growth guidance moved to the upper half of the 17.5%-20% range, with income-before-tax margin near the top of the 20-25% band; no special-situation transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms are disclosed.
